changes: SIMBAD and Hipparcos asked for every star with a parallax of at least 99 mas (about 32.9 ly), not 120
the NASA Exoplanet Archive asked for every confirmed planet within 10.2 pc, not 8.3
the Extrasolar Planets Encyclopaedia asked for every planet within 10.3 pc, not 8.4
a Gaia DR3 identifier read without its words: three had kept the 3 of "DR3", 20 digits that no Gaia source has, and made Gaia time out
an answer holding Infinity or NaN, which are not JSON, read with no value there
exoplanet-eu-neighbourhood-http: the archive wrote one value as Infinity, which is not JSON: read as no value (null)
gaia-dr3-by-id-2: gaia-dr3-by-id-0 timed out and was asked again in three parts, without three identifiers read wrongly (Proxima Centauri's, Barnard's Star's and Epsilon Eridani's, all in the census)

description: The real neighbourhood beyond the census, out to about 33 light-years (a parallax of 99 mas or more), as the archives answered on 2026-10-22 through Starman Reborn's sky pipeline, run on a copy with the shell's limits: stars from Gaia DR3 and SIMBAD, known planets from the NASA Exoplanet Archive and the Extrasolar Planets Encyclopaedia, belts and debris discs from the papers SIMBAD links. Positions are Sol-centred equatorial Cartesian light-years at epoch J2016.0. No old lane reaches it.
